metadata.desc: Call free APIs from UApiPro, supporting hitokoto, weather, IP lookup with card-style image responses.

uapi_token.hint: Get your API token from uapis.cn

uapi_cd.hint: Minimum interval between two command triggers (5 s recommended)

llm_tools_enabled.hint: When enabled, the LLM can call query tools based on conversation context; when disabled, only manual /u commands work

uapi_text_mode.hint: When enabled, the bot will only send text results instead of images

random_img_categories.hint: Select the categories you want to include

news_schedule_enabled.hint: Enable scheduled daily news delivery at a fixed time

news_groups.hint: Enter one group ID per line, press Enter to add

news_users.hint: Enter one QQ ID per line, press Enter to add

ocr_settings.hint: Configure text recognition options for /u ocr command and LLM tool calls.

return_markdown.hint: When enabled, additionally format output as Markdown, suitable for receipts and table-like images.

enable_cls.hint: When enabled, automatically correct rotation or skew from phone photos to improve recognition accuracy.

hitokoto_advanced.hint: Configure advanced mode for /u hitokoto command and LLM tools (scene recommendation / daily quote / source & tag filters).

enabled.hint: When enabled, /u hitokoto uses the mode and filters below; when disabled, the basic random endpoint is used.

mode.hint: random: random quote; daily: fixed daily quote (great for check-in); recommend: scene-based recommendation (requires scene selection); moment: auto-adapt to time of day.

scene.hint: Only effective when mode is 'recommend'; ignored in other modes.

source.hint: Restrict quotes to specific source corpus; leave empty for no restriction.

category.hint: Restrict quotes to specific categories; multiple selections allowed; leave empty for no restriction.

tag.hint: Restrict quotes to specific tags; multiple selections allowed; leave empty for no restriction.

github_user_settings.hint: Configure query parameters for the /u gh command and LLM tool calls.

activity.hint: When enabled, returns last-year contribution stats (total, commits/issues/PRs breakdown, top months).

activity_scope.hint: all: all contributions; organization: only contributions for the organization below.

org.hint: When set, contributions are scoped to this organization (treated as organization scope). Leave empty to use the scope above.

pinned.hint: Whether to return the pinned repositories shown on the user's profile.

repos.hint: Whether to return the user's recently active public repositories.

repos_limit.hint: Max number of recently active repositories to return (1-100).

matting_settings.hint: Default segmentation model, output mode and refinement options for the /u matting (抠图) command.

output.hint: cutout transparent subject / mask grayscale alpha / background solid color (requires color, supports jpeg)

background_color.hint: Only applied when output=background, e.g. ID-photo blue #438EDB

out_format.hint: jpeg does not support transparency and must be combined with output=background

threshold.hint: Values > 0 remove semi-transparent pixels for sharper edges; 0 keeps the native gradient

feather_px.hint: Pixels radius to soften harsh edges; 0 disables feathering
